skill_name: Can you recommend a chocolate cake recipe for two?
workflow: Yes, here is a simple recipe for a two-person chocolate cake. You will need 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cocoa powder, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup butter or margarine, 2 eggs, 1 teaspoon baking powder, and 1 tablespoon vanilla extract. Preheat the oven to 350°. Grease an 8-inch round cake pan with butter or non-stick cooking spray. In a medium bowl, add the flour, cocoa powder, sugar and baking powder and mix together.
